body:
I have had one cap of mushrooms per day for a month now. I dosed last night around 11:30pm and could still feel the residuals this morning on my way to the grocery store. I bought a mango agua fresca and sipped it on the way home around 10:30am.
I entered the apartment at 10:54am and began to notice that I felt like I had taken four caps. I looked over at the juice and remembered that mango is rumored to potentiate the conversion of psilocin into psylocybin. I have fasted for a week and a half now and so my sensitivities were already heightened.
I have fasted for a week and a half now and so my sensitivities were already heightened.
(11:10am) I stood there, thirsty, and afraid to take another sip. The drink had got me.
(11:41am) Still high. Colors are brighter. There is a pulsating reverberation of energy throughout my body. My hands feel like they are on fire. Why couldn't this be a Saturday night?
(12:02pm) I get some water and start to feel less stuck. I drink some apple juice. The pulsations are in my head now. I can feel the energy traveling in and out of me.
This is something I would have again.
